switch_caps.delivered_scene_comparison: Existing sorted-first8 mainpanel rectangular cutout selection resolves toS17-S24, matching the original photo. No color reassignment is required.

verified_control_label_facts.S3: Numbered1-16 selector ring; no BANK word visible

label_layout_limitations: This is a factual label transcription and reference mapping, not a reproduction of the original typography, strokes or silkscreen coordinates.
The current scene x0xb0x title and SYNTHESIZER / SEQUENCER subtitle are presentation additions; they are absent from this original photographed aluminium panel.
The original panel does not use the generic WAVEFORM, BANK or MODE labels shown by the scene proxies. S1 is marked SAW/SQR; selectors use rings and mode legends.
